monthly-net.sql:
SELECT SUBSTR(paid_at,1,7) AS month,
       SUM(paid_amount_cents) AS paid_cents,
       SUM(refunded_amount_cents) AS refund_cents,
       SUM(paid_amount_cents-refunded_amount_cents) AS net_cents,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS paid_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS known_customers
FROM demo_order_detail
WHERE is_test=0 AND paid_amount_cents>0
  AND paid_at >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(paid_at,1,7) ORDER BY month;

channel-contribution.sql:
WITH channel_months AS (
  SELECT channel,SUBSTR(paid_at,1,7) AS month,
         SUM(paid_amount_cents-refunded_amount_cents) AS net_cents
  FROM demo_order_detail
  WHERE is_test=0 AND paid_amount_cents>0
    AND paid_at >= '2026-02-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z'
  GROUP BY channel,SUBSTR(paid_at,1,7)
), changes AS (
  SELECT channel,
         SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-02' THEN net_cents ELSE 0 END) AS previous_net_cents,
         SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-03' THEN net_cents ELSE 0 END) AS current_net_cents
  FROM channel_months GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT channel,previous_net_cents,current_net_cents,
       current_net_cents-previous_net_cents AS delta_cents,
       SUM(current_net_cents-previous_net_cents) OVER () AS total_delta_cents
FROM changes ORDER BY channel;

tagged-net.sql:
SELECT SUBSTR(d.paid_at,1,7) AS month,
       SUM(d.paid_amount_cents) AS paid_cents,
       SUM(d.refunded_amount_cents) AS refund_cents,
       SUM(d.paid_amount_cents-d.refunded_amount_cents) AS net_cents,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.customer_id) AS known_customers
FROM demo_order_detail d
WHERE d.is_test=0 AND d.paid_amount_cents>0
  AND d.paid_at >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' AND d.paid_at < '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_tags t WHERE t.customer_id=d.customer_id AND t.tag IN ('vip','newsletter'))
GROUP BY SUBSTR(d.paid_at,1,7) ORDER BY month;

refund-timing.sql:
SELECT SUBSTR(p.event_at,1,7) AS month,
       SUM(p.amount_cents) AS refund_cents,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS refund_orders
FROM raw_order_lines l JOIN raw_payments p
  ON l.order_id=p.order_id AND l.line_id=p.line_id
WHERE l.is_test=0 AND p.event_status='success' AND p.event_type='refund'
  AND p.event_at >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.event_at < '2026-04-04T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(p.event_at,1,7) ORDER BY month;
